command.name: security key-manager onboard show-backup
command.description: This command displays the backup information for the Onboard Key Manager for the admin Vserver, which can be used to recover the cluster in case of catastrophic situations. The information displayed is for the cluster as a whole (not individual nodes).

example.p: The following example displays the Onboard Key Manager backup data for the admin Vserver:
